parsed.post: Discarding the latest run (0.9768) as it regressed from my best (0.9752). It seems my previous best (0ab0591) was a lucky fluctuation or better luck with the random seed. I will now try to improve on 0.9752 by reducing the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 131072 to increase optimizer steps within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 131072 to increase the frequency of optimizer updates within the fixed 5-minute training budget, while keeping the high-capacity DEPTH=10 and existing regularization.
